| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `[作成、更新、確認など]` | `YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss ±HH:mm` | `YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss ±HH:mm` | `[例: 1時間20分]` | `[名前]` |

## 書き方

- Record product, scope, delivery, and governance decisions here.
- Use an ADR for architecture decisions that require alternatives and technical consequences.
- Do not delete superseded decisions; link the replacement and explain why it changed.
